configSource.description: Where one framework config file came from (scripts/lib/config.mjs configSource, docs/packaging.md §3.4): the framework's own copy, the framework's copy with the workspace's atf/<name> overlay merged over it, or the workspace's ejected atf/config/<name>. files: its sources, base first, workspace-relative with `/` (absolute outside the workspace). digest: sha256 of the effective text; null when it could not be read at init.

layoutVersion.description: The artifact-contract version the run was started on (scripts/lib/contract.mjs CONTRACT_VERSION, docs/packaging.md §3.10; named before packaging). init --resume refuses a run on another contract until npx atf migrate has migrated the workspace.

api_urls.description: API hosts of the same product; the guard treats them as the target (D-045).

mode.description: Single source of truth for the safety mode; caps every agent's permissions.

steps.description: The steps chosen for this run (run-config `steps`, frozen at init; the gap menu may change them through run.mjs steps). Absent in older runs = all six. Every stage outside the chosen set (lib/contract.mjs chosenStages) is not-chosen.

caseTypes.description: The test case types this run derives from its steps and testcases.types: ui always, api with playwright-api, performance with k6.

testcasesMode.description: The testcases stage's mode per module (D-066, lib/contract.mjs testcasesModes): generate for every module when the testcases step is chosen; import for a module whose imported cases need converting or linking although testcases is not chosen (run.mjs steps --import-mode): the writer only converts and links, and the generated coverage items are deferred (reason import). A module not listed has no testcases stage this run. Absent in older runs: generate when testcases is chosen, else none.

environment.description: The environment the run works in (D-081, run-config environment, the session's ATF_ENV); absent in older runs = default.

provenance.description: What the run was made with (D-077, scripts/lib/provenance.mjs): absent in older runs.

package.description: The framework package the run was started with, from its own package.json (scripts/lib/provenance.mjs packageOf, docs/packaging.md §3.10); null when it couldn't be read. init --resume refuses a run whose package is on another breaking line (releaseLine). Absent in runs that predate it, which resume as compatible.

plugin.description: The Claude Code plugin the run's session used (docs/packaging.md §3.12, scripts/lib/provenance.mjs pluginProvenance): in plugin mode (atf/atf.json claude_plugin), the version it recorded in artifacts/.atf-plugin.json, which init requires to be the package's; null outside plugin mode or with none recorded. Absent in runs that predate it.

config.description: Every framework config file in scripts/lib/config.mjs CONFIG_FILES order, untouched ones as `framework`. permissions.yaml here is the workspace's default; a run-config's own permissions_file replaces it, which shows as a permissionsPath other than this entry's files[0] (scripts/report-data.mjs customConfig). Absent in runs that predate config overrides.

packageChanges.description: Each init --resume on another version of the package within the run's breaking line, in order (scripts/run.mjs resumeRun, docs/packaging.md §3.10): the run's provenance keeps the release it started with, and end carries these into state/history/. Absent when the run never changed version.

startedOnHost.description: Host the run was started on, as guessed by run.mjs init (keys of scripts/lib/hosts.mjs HOSTS).

stages.description: Keyed '<scope>/<stage>' where scope is '_product' or a module slug.

reviewFailed.description: the domain's review used up its rounds with findings open: final, dependants are blocked (G10)

findings.description: the open blocker/major findings of a failed review

interrupted.description: init --resume found the stage still running: the session that ran it ended, so the attempt counts as failed and next offers it again while attempts remain (D-071)

reused.description: done by run.mjs next: the knowledge was reused

carriedFrom.description: adopted from this earlier run, which ended awaiting-approval

reopened.description: why run.mjs steps --reopen sent this completed testcases stage back to pending (new case types, or import mode turning into generate); the human approvals of unchanged cases stand

previous.description: the stage's ended attempts, oldest first (D-113): kept when a new attempt starts or the stage is reopened; history only, nothing decides on it
